title: Marine Corps Exchange - Pendleton

sections.heading: Pacific Views MCX
sections.markdown:
The Pacific Views Marine Corps Exchange (MCX) is 147,000 Sq Ft of one-stop shopping. It is the largest exchange in the Marine Corps and is located at the Main Gate across from Pacific Plaza and the Commissary.

The largest Exchange in the MCX system offers a wide variety of merchandise: Women and Men Apparel, Young Adult Clothing, Kids and Baby Clothing, Infant and Baby Merchandise and Accessories, Shoes for the Family, Home Small Appliances, Kitchen & Dining, Household Essentials Items, Patio & Garden, Toys, Electronics including Apple Products, Video Games, Movies, Music & Books, Sports & Outdoors, Beauty, Personal Care, Health, Pets, Luggage, School & Office Supplies, Party Supplies, Cards and gift wrap, Beer, Wine, Grocery Items and Seasonal Good.

sections.heading: Super Star Student
sections.markdown:
The Super Star Student Program is open to students (authorized patrons) in grades K-12, whether enrolled in a traditional classroom or home-schooled. Eligible students will receive one scratch-off card with a guaranteed prize, issued as a Super Star Student Gift Card with the value indicated on the card.

To participate, students should visit their MCX within 30 days of receiving their report card. Upon verification that the student meets the eligibility criteria, they will be given one scratch-off card with a guaranteed prize. Each student is eligible to win one MCX gift card, valued at $5, $10, $25, $50, $100, or $250.

Students who earn a B, S, or 3 average or higher during a grading period are eligible for the program. In California, the program follows the California Common Core State Standards: "Qualifying students who achieve a 2.0 average or higher in the first or second trimester, or a 3.0 average or higher in the third trimester, qualify as Super Star Students."

**Program Exclusions**

• Scratch-off cards are non-transferable and cannot be shared between individuals.
• Once a store has distributed all of their scratch-off cards for a given period (e.g., September this year through August the following year), additional cards will not be available until the next "Back to School" campaign.

Thank you all for your support and goodwill in helping our Super Star Student program continue to grow, succeed, and be a true benefit to our students!

sections.heading: Ship To Store
sections.markdown:
The Navy & Marine Corps shopping benefit just got bigger! Shop online at myMCX.com and have your order shipped to your nearest participating MCX in just 3-5 days stateside or 7-10 days abroad!

All Ship to Store orders for Camp Pendleton, CA come with FREE shipping and are eligible for pick up at three locations: Pacific Views MCX, San Onofre Marine Mart, or Mainside Marine Mart.

Families of authorized shoppers are welcome to experience all that the MCX offers with discounted prices and tax-free shopping. Authorized patrons must be present.

sections.heading: Recreational Shooting MCX Firearm Promo
sections.markdown:
New to shooting or purchasing a firearm?

Get free safety and instruction with your MCX firearms purchase at Recreational Shooting, Camp Pendleton! This offer is perfect for new firearms owners looking for a safe and educational experience. Call today and book space at the range!

MCX Sales receipt is required to book this free offer, please call (760) 212-1973.
